note: fixture for the covenant pack: the classic study query.
The honest expectedTop for this query is Genesis 15 or 17 — both
OUTSIDE the fixture corpus (Genesis chapters present: 1,2,3,5,16), so
asserting them would fail structurally, and a mustNotRank on them
would pass vacuously. Galatians 3:15-18 is the in-corpus anchor that
reads the Abrahamic covenant forward ('the promises were spoken to
Abraham... a covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ') — a
defensible top for the query on this corpus. withinTop 5 because the
pack's higher-weighted anchors (Jer 31:31-34, Luke 22:20) also fire
for any covenant-concept query and may legitimately sit above it.
If the corpus-extension request in the pack notes (Genesis 15 + 17)
is approved, re-point expectedTop at Genesis 15:7-18 and demote this
